race.comment: MOONHAVEN (5) has returned in good order and gets the nod after missing by under a length at Eagle Farm in Saturday company. Relishes this trip and can put it all together to salute fourth-up. SHIRVINGTON (7) has gone back to the trials after a flat first-up outing at Eagle Farm and gets blinkers first time race day. Drawn cosy and with the weight relief he can get back to his best second-up. MAXIMUM OUTPUT (1) was only just denied by BLITZBURG at this track as favourite last start and has the track-and-distance record to keep him right in the mix. Expect him to spear across from his gate and give backers another bold sight. BLITZBURG (2) backs up quickly from a poor performance at Doomben. He's much better than that, as seen two back when running down MO.
